name: Phrynoderma
advice: Eat vitamin A-rich foods (green leafy vegetables, carrots, papaya, mango, milk, eggs). Report night blindness or dry eyes — needs eye check. High-dose vitamin A is not given in pregnancy (use low daily dose). Check for fat malabsorption and other deficiencies.

ref: Wolverton 4e ch 55; WHO vitamin A deficiency protocol

rx.instr: Not in pregnancy — use ≤10,000 IU/day instead
